sources.supports: Google's Gemini 3 guide lists the preview model at $0.25 per million input tokens and image output priced at $0.067 per image; the footnote says pricing is per million tokens unless otherwise noted and image pricing varies by resolution.

sources.quote: February 26, 2026 Launched Nano Banana 2, Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview, a high-efficiency model optimized for speed and high-volume use cases.
sources.supports: Google's release notes identify the model as a Preview launch on February 26, 2026.
The current pricing page lists $0.50 input for the Standard tier of the later Gemini 3.1 Flash Image model.

notes: Google's model-specific guide still lists the Preview endpoint at $0.25 input, consistent with the earlier models.dev value; the later $0.50 figure appears as the Standard tier price for the GA model, while Batch is $0.25. No provider source located states that the Preview endpoint's price changed or dates a transition, so this is best classified as a models.dev correction and no effective date is assigned. Internet Archive's CDX endpoint returned its 'Temporarily Offline' page, preventing archived pricing-page verification.
